captions.detailed: A 3D-printable chisel model featuring a long, solid rectangular handle and a wedge-shaped blade. The handle has a square cross-section, while the blade tapers smoothly on one side down to a fine, flat cutting edge. The entire model is a single, continuous solid piece with flat, planar surfaces.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric 3D-printable chisel in OpenSCAD. The script should allow users to customize the handle length (L), handle width (w), handle height (h), blade length (t), blade width (b), and minimum tip thickness (a) to generate a customized wedge-shaped chisel.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a union of two main parts: a rectangular handle and a wedge blade. The handle is built using a centered cube primitive. The wedge blade is generated using a hull operation that spans between a thin slice at the front of the handle and a rotated, offset thin cube representing the fine cutting edge.
